title: Luxuriant Low Fat Russian Porcini Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful Russian stew featuring porcini mushrooms, cooked in a traditional ttukbaegi earthenware pot, with a focus on low fat ingredients. This dish is perfect for a cold winter evening.
instructions: Heat the earthenware pot over medium heat and add the chopped onion, cooking until softened.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the dried porcini mushrooms, vegetable broth, tomato paste, and dried thyme, stirring to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Add the chopped carrots and potatoes, continuing to simmer for an additional 20-25 minutes, until the vegetables are tender.
Season the stew with salt and pepper to taste, serving hot.
Garnish with fresh herbs, if desired.
Serve with a side of whole grain bread or over mashed potatoes.
Refrigerate or freeze any leftovers for up to 3 days.
Reheat the stew gently over low heat, adding a little water if needed to achieve the desired consistency.
